method.purpose: Surface likely admission-veto/manual-correction candidates before product SRS admission sampling review.
method.selection: Rows are grouped by mechanical risk families: open manual watchlist, unhandled exporter flags, same-surface rare readings, single-kanji component-like rows, kana-preferred kanji display rows, and low-support early rows.
method.non_goal: The script does not decide corrections automatically; it only creates a reproducible review queue.

hypothesis_tracking.failure_mode: stale watch rows may no longer be actionable
manual correction may be overly conservative
flags mix display-only issues with true admission vetoes
valid literary or specialized readings can be real vocabulary
